_comment: Observables (test). Placed at the placeholder rocks. World coords: 32px tiles, region 48x48, player spawns at (768,768). Real content comes with authored regions + the LDtk object layer.

tiers.text: A stone, half-sunk in the grass.
Worn smooth. Water shaped it, once, where none runs now.
A dry channel in the earth. A stream ran here.
How quiet it is, out here.

conclusions.text: People lived here once. The water drew them; the water left.
